title: HubEgo-100K: first 10,000 hours of a planned 100,000-hour first-person work video dataset released in LeRobot format
headline: HubEgo-100K: 10,000 hours of first-person work video
lede: You can train on 10,000 hours of first-person job footage from 12,000+ people across 62,000+ tasks, CC BY 4.0, in LeRobot format.

effects.effect: Large egocentric video for video models
Open human footage for pretraining manipulation policies

possibilities.title: Robot startups can check task coverage, not just scene similarity, before quoting
possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-12 Magpie suggested robot startups index egocentric work video to check data coverage for a client task before quoting; today's HubEgo-100K adds 10,000 hours across 62,000+ tasks in LeRobot format, so retrieval can filter by task before ranking by look.
